Position:
Company Secretary since August 2002.
Skills and experience:
Ms. Ngobi was educated in both Kenya
and the UK and qualified as a lawyer in
1985. She previously worked with Unilever
Kenya Limited for 15 years as Company
Secretary before joining British American
Tobacco Kenya Ltd in 2002 as Company
Secretary and Area Legal Counsel. She
retired from full time employment with
British American Tobacco Kenya Ltd in
2010 but retained her role as Company
Secretary. She founded Cosec Solutions
which provides company secretarial
services and corporate governance
solutions to various companies.
Key Appointments:
She is a Non- Executive Director on the
Boards of CFC Stanbic Bank Limited and
CFC Stanbic Holdings Limited.
